scenarios.testName: applies owner migration 0026 after the complete Milestone 2 MarkReg schema
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Order tables and owner migration history are present and verified

scenarios.testName: upgrades the prior Milestone 2 MarkReg schema without rewriting committed evidence
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Prior Customer Confirmation evidence survives the forward Order migration

scenarios.testName: persists exact lifecycle, audit and idempotent command results across a fresh pool
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Draft through ReadyForMatter reloads with exact version and audit trail

scenarios.testName: returns exact replay after restart and rejects different input under the same key
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Order-to-Matter result replays identically after a fresh pool

scenarios.testName: OUT-MARKREG-STARTUP preserves the causal failure then restores the durable MarkReg listener and reusable port
scenarios.expectedEvidence: MarkReg owner database startup failure is typed/redacted and listener restoration succeeds on current M3 schema

scenarios.testName: maps unavailable reads to the canonical persistence error
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Order repository runtime outage maps to PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE

scenarios.testName: maps a database outage without leaking driver details
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Conversion outage fails closed without leaking driver detail

scenarios.testName: replays identical create, rejects conflicting key reuse and rejects a second Order for the exact source
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Identical replay is deterministic and duplicate source/idempotency conflicts are rejected

scenarios.testName: serializes concurrent writers so one exact expected version wins
scenarios.expectedEvidence: One optimistic update wins and one fails with VERSION_CONFLICT

scenarios.testName: serializes concurrent identical conversion so both callers observe one Matter
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Concurrent identical conversion produces one Formal Matter and one stable result

scenarios.testName: rejects stale Order version or source hash before writing conversion truth
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Stale optimistic version/source writes no Matter truth

scenarios.testName: rolls back the Order when Formal Matter creation fails
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Injected Formal Matter create failure leaves Order ReadyForMatter and creates no Matter

scenarios.testName: rolls back newly created Matter when Order link audit fails
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Injected Order audit failure leaves no orphan Matter or conversion command

scenarios.testName: enforces typed auth, spoof, tenant and conflict boundaries
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Gateway authentication, actor/workspace truth and cross-Workspace boundaries fail closed

scenarios.testName: conceals a cross-Workspace compatibility Matter and leaves Order unchanged
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Cross-Workspace Matter link is non-enumerating and non-mutating
No skipped tests and identical passed-test totals across both cycles

scenarios.testName: desktop and mobile durable Order journey real runtime
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Customer Confirmation through MatterCreated survives refresh/direct URL/back/workspace switch on desktop and 390px mobile
